title: School Parent Group
description: Five parents who met through their children's elementary school in Minneapolis, connected through PTA committees, carpools, neighborhood proximity, and shared yoga classes. Rich in family details, professional backgrounds, school activities, and community involvement.

people.name: Diane Johansson
people.profile: Swedish-American, born in Duluth. Pediatrician at Children's Minnesota hospital. PTA president at Burroughs Elementary. Married to Erik, a high school history teacher. Two kids: Astrid (9) and Lars (6).

observations.text: Diane Johansson is a pediatrician at Children's Minnesota hospital, specializing in childhood asthma and allergies.
Diane Johansson grew up in Duluth, Minnesota, where her parents still run a Swedish bakery called Johansson's on Superior Street.
Diane Johansson is the PTA president at Burroughs Community Elementary School in Minneapolis for the 2024-2025 school year.
Diane Johansson and Kevin Washington are both on the PTA fundraising committee and co-chaired the fall gala that raised $18,000.
Diane Johansson's daughter Astrid, age 9, is in the same fourth-grade class as Kevin's son Marcus at Burroughs Elementary.
Diane Johansson's husband Erik teaches AP U.S. History at Southwest High School in Minneapolis.
Diane Johansson's son Lars, age 6, is in first grade at Burroughs and plays on the school's peewee soccer team.
Diane Johansson and Mei-Lin Zhou are neighbors on Oliver Avenue South in the Linden Hills neighborhood, with houses three doors apart.
Diane Johansson organized a school-wide health screening at Burroughs in October 2024, checking 340 students' vision and hearing.
Diane Johansson drives a silver 2023 Volvo XC90 and uses it for the Tuesday-Thursday carpool to Burroughs.
Diane Johansson ran the Twin Cities Marathon in October 2024 with a time of 3 hours 52 minutes.
Diane Johansson bakes Swedish cardamom buns called kardemummabullar for every PTA meeting.
Diane Johansson traveled to Stockholm with her family in June 2024 to visit her cousin Ingrid and attend Midsommar celebrations.
Diane Johansson's favorite book is 'Being Mortal' by Atul Gawande.
Diane Johansson speaks English and conversational Swedish, which she learned from her grandmother.
Diane Johansson volunteers at a free clinic in Phillips neighborhood every other Saturday morning, seeing uninsured children.
Diane Johansson coached Lars's peewee soccer team to an undefeated season in the fall 2024 rec league.
Diane Johansson and Tomoko Hashimoto take the same 6:30 AM yoga class at CorePower Yoga in Uptown every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
Diane Johansson donated 50 children's books to the Burroughs school library in memory of her late mother, who was a librarian.
Diane Johansson planted a vegetable garden in her backyard that produced 80 pounds of tomatoes in the summer of 2024.

people.name: Kevin Washington
people.profile: African-American, grew up in St. Paul. Architect at a downtown Minneapolis firm. Single father of Marcus (9) and Zoe (7). Active PTA member and youth basketball coach.

observations.text: Kevin Washington is a senior architect at HGA Architects in downtown Minneapolis, specializing in sustainable school design.
Kevin Washington grew up in the Rondo neighborhood of St. Paul, Minnesota.
Kevin Washington and Diane Johansson are both on the PTA fundraising committee and co-chaired the fall gala.
Kevin Washington is a single father; he has full custody of his son Marcus (9) and daughter Zoe (7) after his divorce in 2021.
Kevin Washington's son Marcus is in the same fourth-grade class as Diane's daughter Astrid at Burroughs Elementary.
Kevin Washington and Luis Herrera carpool together on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, alternating who drives to Burroughs.
Kevin Washington coaches the Burroughs Elementary youth basketball team and led them to the city rec league semifinals in March 2024.
Kevin Washington designed the new Burroughs Elementary playground, which was built in summer 2024 using recycled materials.
Kevin Washington's mother, Gloria, is a retired school principal who now tutors neighborhood kids at the St. Paul Public Library.
Kevin Washington drives a white 2022 Tesla Model Y and charges it at the free station at his office.
Kevin Washington lives in a renovated craftsman bungalow on Dupont Avenue South in the Linden Hills neighborhood.
Kevin Washington's daughter Zoe takes violin lessons at MacPhail Center for Music every Saturday and performed in the spring recital in May 2024.
Kevin Washington won an AIA Minnesota Honor Award in 2024 for his design of the new Hmong Cultural Center in St. Paul.
Kevin Washington's favorite book is 'The Death and Life of Great American Cities' by Jane Jacobs.
Kevin Washington built a model of the Foshay Tower out of LEGO bricks with Marcus, using 3,200 pieces, and displayed it at the school art fair.
Kevin Washington runs a free after-school architecture and design club at Burroughs on Thursdays for 12 students.
Kevin Washington traveled to Copenhagen in August 2024 to study Danish school architecture and visited six schools in five days.
Kevin Washington's annual backyard barbecue on the Fourth of July has become a tradition for the parent group, with 35 guests in 2024.
Kevin Washington speaks English and is learning Mandarin using Duolingo because Marcus's best friend speaks Mandarin at home.
Kevin Washington cooks breakfast for Marcus and Zoe every morning — pancakes on weekdays and eggs benedict on weekends.

people.name: Mei-Lin Zhou
people.profile: Chinese-American, born in Shanghai. Product manager at Target's Minneapolis headquarters. Married to James, a dentist. One daughter: Lily (8). Active in school volunteering and neighborhood activities.

observations.text: Mei-Lin Zhou is a senior product manager at Target Corporation's headquarters in downtown Minneapolis, working on their mobile app team.
Mei-Lin Zhou was born in Shanghai, China, and moved to the United States at age 14 when her father took a research position at the University of Minnesota.
Mei-Lin Zhou and Diane Johansson are neighbors on Oliver Avenue South in the Linden Hills neighborhood, with houses three doors apart.
Mei-Lin Zhou's daughter Lily, age 8, is in third grade at Burroughs Elementary and is best friends with Luis's daughter Sofia.
Mei-Lin Zhou and Tomoko Hashimoto volunteer together at the Burroughs Elementary school library every Wednesday afternoon, shelving books and reading to first graders.
Mei-Lin Zhou's husband James is a dentist with a private practice called Linden Hills Family Dental on 43rd Street.
Mei-Lin Zhou organized a Chinese New Year celebration at Burroughs in February 2024, teaching 120 students to make dumplings.
Mei-Lin Zhou speaks Mandarin, Shanghainese, and English fluently.
Mei-Lin Zhou drives a blue 2023 BMW X3 and handles the Wednesday carpool for Lily and Sofia to their after-school Mandarin class.
Mei-Lin Zhou's father, Dr. Wei Zhou, is a retired physics professor at the University of Minnesota.
Mei-Lin Zhou traveled to Shanghai with Lily in July 2024 to visit her grandmother, who turned 90.
Mei-Lin Zhou completed a half-marathon at Grandma's Marathon in Duluth in June 2024 with a time of 2 hours 5 minutes.
Mei-Lin Zhou teaches a weekend Mandarin class for children at the Minnesota Chinese Cultural Center, with 15 students including Lily.
Mei-Lin Zhou's favorite book is 'Educated' by Tara Westover.
Mei-Lin Zhou baked 200 mooncakes for the Burroughs Elementary Mid-Autumn Festival celebration in September 2024.
Mei-Lin Zhou built a Little Free Library in front of her house on Oliver Avenue, stocking it with bilingual English-Mandarin children's books.
Mei-Lin Zhou plays piano and performs with the Linden Hills Community Orchestra, which gives two concerts a year at Lake Harriet Bandshell.
Mei-Lin Zhou's daughter Lily won the Burroughs Elementary spelling bee in November 2024 with the word 'chrysanthemum'.
Mei-Lin Zhou makes xiaolongbao from scratch every Sunday and has taught Diane Johansson the technique.
Mei-Lin Zhou led the PTA effort to install a new all-weather track at Burroughs, securing a $25,000 grant from Target's community fund.

people.name: Luis Herrera
people.profile: Mexican-American, born in Puebla. Owns a Mexican restaurant in Uptown Minneapolis. Married to Maria, a nurse. Two kids: Sofia (8) and Diego (5). Runs the school garden program.

observations.text: Luis Herrera owns and operates El Pueblito, a Mexican restaurant on Hennepin Avenue in Uptown Minneapolis.
Luis Herrera was born in Puebla, Mexico, and moved to Minneapolis at age 18 to work in his uncle's restaurant.
Luis Herrera and Kevin Washington carpool together on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, alternating who drives to Burroughs.
Luis Herrera's daughter Sofia, age 8, is best friends with Mei-Lin's daughter Lily and they are in the same third-grade class.
Luis Herrera coordinates the Burroughs Elementary school garden program, where students grow tomatoes, peppers, squash, and herbs.
Luis Herrera and Tomoko Hashimoto are neighbors on Upton Avenue South, living directly across the street from each other.
Luis Herrera's wife Maria is a labor and delivery nurse at Abbott Northwestern Hospital.
Luis Herrera's son Diego, age 5, is in kindergarten at Burroughs and is learning to read in both English and Spanish.
Luis Herrera won 'Best New Restaurant' from Minneapolis Star Tribune's Taste section in 2022 for El Pueblito.
Luis Herrera speaks Spanish and English fluently and teaches a kids' cooking class in Spanish at El Pueblito on Saturday mornings.
Luis Herrera drives a red 2021 Chevrolet Silverado that he uses to haul supplies for both the restaurant and the school garden.
Luis Herrera catered the PTA fall gala in November 2024, providing tacos al pastor, elote, and churros for 200 guests.
Luis Herrera traveled to Puebla with his family in April 2024 to visit his mother Rosa and attend his nephew's first communion.
Luis Herrera's school garden produced 120 pounds of tomatoes in 2024, which were used in the school cafeteria.
Luis Herrera's favorite cookbook is 'Oaxaca: Home Cooking from the Heart of Mexico' by Bricia Lopez.
Luis Herrera built three raised garden beds at Burroughs in April 2024 using cedar planks he milled himself.
Luis Herrera makes fresh tortillas at El Pueblito every morning starting at 5 AM using heirloom corn masa from a farm in Iowa.
Luis Herrera organized a Cinco de Mayo fiesta at Burroughs in May 2024, with a piñata, folk dancing, and a taco bar for 300 people.
Luis Herrera plays guitar in a mariachi band called Los Hermanos del Norte that performs at community events around Minneapolis.
Luis Herrera's restaurant El Pueblito donates 30 meals per week to the Burroughs Elementary free lunch program.

people.name: Tomoko Hashimoto
people.profile: Japanese-American, born in Kyoto. Freelance graphic designer working from home. Married to Ryan, a firefighter. One son: Kai (7). Passionate about yoga and children's book illustration.

observations.text: Tomoko Hashimoto is a freelance graphic designer who works from her home studio, specializing in children's book illustration and branding for small businesses.
Tomoko Hashimoto was born in Kyoto, Japan, and moved to Minneapolis in 2014 after marrying her husband Ryan, whom she met while he was teaching English in Japan.
Tomoko Hashimoto and Diane Johansson take the same 6:30 AM yoga class at CorePower Yoga in Uptown every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
Tomoko Hashimoto and Mei-Lin Zhou volunteer together at the Burroughs Elementary school library every Wednesday afternoon.
Tomoko Hashimoto and Luis Herrera are neighbors on Upton Avenue South, living directly across the street from each other.
Tomoko Hashimoto's husband Ryan is a firefighter at Minneapolis Fire Station 28 on Lake Street.
Tomoko Hashimoto's son Kai, age 7, is in second grade at Burroughs and plays on Lars Johansson's peewee soccer team.
Tomoko Hashimoto illustrated a children's book called 'Koi and the Moon' that was published by a small Minneapolis press in March 2024.
Tomoko Hashimoto speaks Japanese and English fluently.
Tomoko Hashimoto designed the logo and branding for Luis Herrera's restaurant El Pueblito in 2022.
Tomoko Hashimoto drives a white 2021 Mazda CX-5 with a 'Minneapolis Parks' bumper sticker.
Tomoko Hashimoto completed her 200-hour yoga teacher training certification at Yoga Sol in Minneapolis in June 2024.
Tomoko Hashimoto traveled to Kyoto with Kai in August 2024 to visit her parents and attend the Gion Matsuri festival.
Tomoko Hashimoto's favorite book is 'The Tale of Genji' by Murasaki Shikibu.
Tomoko Hashimoto teaches a free kids' art class at the Linden Hills Community Center on Saturday afternoons, with 10-15 students per session.
Tomoko Hashimoto designed the Burroughs Elementary 2024 yearbook cover, featuring watercolor portraits of all 22 teachers.
Tomoko Hashimoto's mother, Sachiko, is a kimono maker in Kyoto who has been practicing the craft for 40 years.
Tomoko Hashimoto makes bento boxes for Kai every school day, each with a different character theme using nori and vegetables.
Tomoko Hashimoto organized a Japanese cultural day at Burroughs in April 2024, teaching 80 students origami and calligraphy.
Tomoko Hashimoto won a Minnesota Book Award nomination for her illustrations in 'Koi and the Moon' in January 2025.
